The '''''Coyn's Tempest''''' was a [[Ye-4 gunship]] that was used as a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] by a band of [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] active in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DtCM" />
